violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer and mixing bowl/attachments) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took units out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Various items were observed held between 44-54 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed TCS items in walk-in cooler for active cooling. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The presence of small flies are not controlled as evidenced by live small flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Slicer food pusher located in the kitchen area was not in good repair. Inspector observed cracks in plastic food pusher. PIC took unit out of service and placed a "Do Not Use" sign on slicer. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the speed rack and speed rack cover have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
Inspector observed leak coming from back kitchen area ceiling (near 3 bay sink and hand sink areas). Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Paper and dirt debris, condensate drain lines were observed in the designated hand-washing sink in the dishwash area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (lettuce, produce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (stand mixer, mixer bowl, slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. All equipment taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Cheesecake was observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit in the display case. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Deli meats were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Bagged onions and beverages were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in; bottled beverages were observed stored on the floor in the storage area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The following were observed in poor repair: -dish machine (leaking) -pizza prep gaskets (torn) -display case (ambient 48 degrees F). New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -speed rack and cover -lids to pizza dough containers -pressure cooker -prep unit gaskets -tabletop under cooktop. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The following have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris: -walls behind cookline equipment -walk-in fan guard. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
Several ceiling tiles were observed missing/removed in the rear storage area. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
